WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    CAST(telescope_count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS DECIMAL) as share,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) as rn
  FROM telescope_counts
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share
FROM shares
WHERE rn <= 10 OR share = (SELECT share FROM shares WHERE rn = 10)
ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Only observatories with at least one telescope in the database are included. Observatories in the observatories table with no associated telescopes are excluded.
